| '''Brick'''
| One of the small, single-purpose <code>aw*</code> tools; each installs on its own

| '''Operator'''
| A Discord user id allowed to press approval buttons
| [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]

| '''Approval card'''
| Message with Approve / Deny buttons raised before a risky action

|-
| '''Persona'''
| A named voice for <code>/ask</code>, from a <code>&lt;name&gt;.md</code> file
| [[Company Brain/awdiscord configuration variables|Configuration]]
|-
| '''Plugin'''
| A set of slash commands each server enables for itself
| [[Company Brain/Plugins and packs|Plugins and packs]]
|-
| '''Pack'''
| An installable bundle: a plugin pack, or an agent pack (prompt + skills) that becomes a plugin
| [[Company Brain/Plugins and packs|Plugins and packs]]
|-
| '''Home guild'''
| The Discord server the bot’s owner runs, always served
| [[Company Brain/Safety rails|Safety rails]]
|-
| '''BYO model'''
| A server running on its own OpenAI-compatible endpoint
| [[Company Brain/Bring your own model|Bring your own model]]
|-
| '''Harvest'''
| Turning notes into a linked-Markdown wiki
| [[Company Brain/awbrain|awbrain]]
|-
| '''Top-k'''
| Retrieval of only the best k pages, never the whole history
| [[Company Brain/awbrain|awbrain]]
|-
| '''Receipt'''
| Output of <code>awbrain status</code>: sources, pages, claims, embedder mode
